description: Sri Lanka Parliament - Convening of the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Monday, the 30th of June, 2025 at 9.30 a.m.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the convening of Parliament on a specific date and time, which falls under electoral and parliamentary process matters. The notification by the Speaker about summoning Parliament constitutes an official announcement about parliamentary proceedings, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) as it deals with the scheduling and convening of legislative sessions.
